Editor note: apply pacing pads early when a recipient is symptomatic with a slow rate.
Editor note: arrange bronchoscopy and biopsy with the transplant team.
Editor note: ask the patient how to reach the transplant centre and which medicines they take.
Editor note: ask which calcineurin inhibitor product the patient takes and how to reach the transplant centre.
Editor note: before adding or stopping any drug, ask the transplant team or a transplant pharmacist whether it changes the immunosuppressant level.

Editor note: before discharge on oral therapy, check the patient can swallow and keep down tablets, that the repeat CMV DNA, blood count and creatinine are booked, and that the patient knows whom to call.
Editor note: call the transplant team before changing, holding or stopping any immunosuppressant.
Editor note: disposition is decided with the treating transplant team.
Editor note: in a kidney transplant recipient with new graft dysfunction, raise BK with the transplant team.
Editor note: involve a poison centre or a medical toxicologist and the transplant team.
Editor note: name suspected vascular compromise to the transplant team at the first call.
Editor note: record weight, creatinine and a blood count at the first dose.

Editor note: send the CMV QNAT from the ED and tell the transplant team which specimen type (plasma or whole blood) was sent, because the guideline asks that monitoring use the same specimen type and assay.
Editor note: tell the transplant team the creatinine trend, the drug level and the time of the last dose together.
Editor note: tell the transplant team the organ, transplant date, donor and recipient CMV status, and when prophylaxis ended or rejection was treated.
Editor note: tell the transplant team the test was sent and which laboratory ran it.
Editor note: tell the transplant team which blood pressure drug is being given or planned, and any calcineurin inhibitor level drawn.
Editor note: the guideline does not say whether to start an antiviral in the ED before a result is back; agree this with the transplant team before the first dose.

Editor note: the interaction list above is the guideline's Table 4 (calcineurin inhibitor rows) and is not a complete list of interacting drugs; tell the transplant team about any drug started or stopped in the ED.
Editor note: urinary symptoms or an abnormal urinalysis in a transplant recipient still need their own assessment: [Adult UTI](#/tree/adult-uti).
Editor note: use the Hypertensive Emergency (Adult) consult unchanged; tell the transplant team which agent was started; the drug level is rechecked afterwards.
Editor note: write down the time of the last immunosuppressant dose next to the level.
Editor note: write the time of the last dose and the time of the blood draw on the lab request.
Editor note: give the Sepsis consult's empiric antibiotics without delay; the febrile neutropenia pathway's risk score is written for cancer patients; call the transplant team.
Editor note: run the Status Epilepticus consult's first-line treatment unchanged; before a second-line agent, check it against the list on this page; tell the transplant team which agent was given.
